snippet.title: Lost Lures | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Lost Lures Public Playtest now live on Steam!

Play here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4234930/Lost_Lures

Fishing adventure set in the Finnish wilderness. Learn fish behavior, read the water, and choose the right lure. Progress catch by catch through calm, skill-based fishing. Play solo or head out online with friends, complete shared missions, and fish at your own pace.

LOST LURES SOCIALS
►Twitter: https://x.com/LostLuresGame
►Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lostluresgame/
►TikTok: http://tiktok.com/@lostlures
►Discord: https://discord.gg/yNvxcJewbV

CHECK OUT OUR OTHER GAMES
►Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Bonus%20Stage%20Publishing
